sentences.en: Ben is a beginner in this English course.
sentences.zh: 本是这门英语课程的初学者。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits at a desk in a bright classroom with a new, unopened English book, looking a little unsure.

sentences.en: His class has English at school every morning.
sentences.zh: 他们班每天早上在学校上英语课。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) sit with other children in a school classroom in the morning sun.

sentences.narration: Ben and Mia sit with other children in a school classroom in the morning sun.

sentence_targets.en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there.
A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
